devices.label: High-flow oxygen
devices.source: Teaching estimate. The FiO₂ delivered by a reservoir mask at 15 L/min varies with fit and breathing pattern.

devices.label: Venturi mask
devices.source: Fixed-performance device: FiO₂ set by the Venturi valve.

devices.label: Nasal cannula
devices.source: Teaching estimate. Variable-performance device; FiO₂ depends on flow and breathing pattern.

devices.label: Lie flat, raise legs
devices.source: Resuscitation Council UK (2021) anaphylaxis: lie flat, with or without legs raised, if hypotensive; sit up if breathing is difficult. Size of the BP effect is a teaching parameter.

procedures.label: Arterial line
procedures.doneText: Radial arterial line placed. Continuous blood pressure on the monitor.
